name: 3S Viking Status (GMCP)
author: Joakim
description: The settlement half of the Viking HUD, fed by the Guild.* GMCP packages (3Scapes only; the MIP-fed original ships as '3S Viking Status (classic, MIP)' - run one or the other, they answer to the same commands). Tabs: Stats / City / Builds / Production / People / Settlers / Holds / Mission / Trade / Trade Auto / Trade Log / Feeds - the Sea, Voyage, Map, Travel and Plan tabs live in 3s-viking-world (the plan is still computed here and `vplan` still edits it - only the picture moved) (the mission runner's town-travel engine and the vgo/vhere commands stay here). Includes the build planner and the market scanner + auto-trader. Warehouse stock comes straight from the Guild.Warehouse feed (server-side since 28 Aug) with real per-grade freshness; the `vtrade stock` text scan - Refresh button, `vstock`, cart-event and staleness re-scans - remains only as the automatic fallback for a server without that package. An incoming raid (Guild.City raid) shows on the Stats tab's War section, damaged buildings (bdmg) on the Builds tab, and the four guild-xp tracks (buandi/drotta/viga/vitka off Guild.State.gxp - current, advance threshold, last gain) in the Stats tab's GXP section. The Plan grid can wear hand-drawn image tiles (host API 1.17): PNGs in the plugin's tiles/ folder, declared per district character, riding the Icons toggle - name a file, drop the art in, it appears. Per-good stock floors ('atrade floor grain 500') keep a minimum of a good in the warehouse whatever the category reserve says - floored names show blue in the Trade tab, held (never-traded) names amber; the Trade tab's Floor box sets the value, and a right-click on a good's name opens a menu (host API 1.19) - hold/release, set the floor, clear it - with plain rclick=/click= fallbacks for older hosts. The auto-trader knows the cartyard's one-caravan-per-3-minutes rhythm: it holds after every dispatch, reads the yard's own 'Ready in' refusal to set the clock exactly, and never spams doomed carts into the cooldown ('atrade yard <sec>' tunes the hold). Market prices come straight from the Guild.TradeGoods feed (per-village, pushed; the 30 good codes solved mechanically and cross-validated), so the mkref scan burst is retired to a fallback. The trader treats a town's demand as an answer: zero demand gets no cart however good the price, and every dispatched cart provisionally debits the town's demand (or supply, for buys) locally, so quiet stretches between feed pushes can't stack a second caravan into demand the first already claimed - the next feed row restores the server's truth. Town travel is planned from the Guild.Map feed rather than from recorded routes: the east/south edge grids are the territory as a graph, so BFS walks any settlement to any other directly instead of chaining every trip through Midgard, and the routes follow the server when the map changes. The 28 hand-recorded routes are kept as the oracle - a grid that cannot reproduce them is not trusted and the table drives travel instead - and Guild.Map's `pos` must agree with towns whose coordinates are already known before it is allowed to correct any of them. Every place with a name and a coordinate is a destination, since planning no longer needs a recorded route: Jarl and Berserker travel like any town, and a location you name with `vikloc` becomes travelable the moment you name it (the sea plugin hands its names over the event bus, both stores being scoped per plugin). Remaining GMCP feed gaps show honestly in their tabs.
